summary: OS Therapies filed an 8-K disclosing termination of its At Market Issuance Sales Agreement with B. Riley Securities and JonesTrading, effective July 28, 2026. The agreement allowed up to $18M in common stock sales; only 282,679 shares were sold for gross proceeds of ~$530,162, leaving ~$17.47M unsold. No termination fees were due. This is a routine capital-raising facility termination, not a special situation.
